name: upstreamit
description: Job search engine that reads companies’ own ATS hiring APIs (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday), normalizes 330k+ open postings into filterable columns, and never excludes a job for what its posting does not say.
author: Elliot Greenbaum <elliotgreenbaum@gmail.com>
